title: Recruitment closed to students and volunteers
summary: Student and volunteer accounts no longer see Recruitment, and its pages are closed to them.
changes: Hide the Recruitment menu link from student and volunteer accounts.
Close Open roles, My applications, applying, and Recruitment manage pages to student and volunteer accounts.
Keep Open roles available to visitors and to public accounts that have not chosen a service yet.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.41 line: narrows who can use Recruitment with no new screens.
validation: New student and volunteer Recruitment access tests.
Recruitment, navigation, hub, and layout tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Human Resources, Admin, and Super Admin accounts still see separate Recruitment and Recruit manage menu links until a later 0.41 release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
